question: Ants can lift objects that are many times heavier than their own body weight
All ants in a colony have wings
Ants have lungs to breathe oxygen
Some species of ants farm other insects, such as aphids
Ant ears are located on their antennae
An ant colony can have more than one queen
Ants are capable of living in frozen glaciers and permanently icy environments
Fire ants got their name because of their bright red coloration and the burning sensation caused by their sting
The primary role of male ants in a colony is to forage for food and defend the nest
Ants communicate with each other primarily through chemical signals called pheromones
